mechanism_narrative: A one-week plunge in PARKS from +3.3 to -11.1 signals rapid withdrawal from outdoor activity, which precedes reduced browsing and discretionary retail trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last four-week mean despite PARKS remaining below -10.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT falling through -37.7 marks a tightening of movement restrictions that reduces commuting and discretionary trips, causing RETAIL_REC to decline over the following two weeks and remain lower on the four-week mean.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT drops more than 3 points week-on-week (from -34.4 to -37.7).
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last 28-day mean when TRANSIT falls more than 3 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: High RESIDENTIAL (8.9) combined with depressed WORKPLACES (-22.9) locks households into home-based routines, suppressing weekday retail-and-recreation footfall, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last 28-day mean when RESIDENTIAL > 8.5 and WORKPLACES < -20.

mechanism_narrative: In a rollback regime, TRANSIT is the leading indicator: its recent slide to -37.7 alongside WORKPLACES at -22.9 signals imminent closure of non-essential retail, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next week and stays below the prior four-week mean.
failure_condition: In a reopening rollback, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises above its last 28-day mean when TRANSIT < -35.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC climbed from -14.4 to -9.4 over the first three weeks, showing a positive momentum that persists despite the t-0 dip, so the next four-week mean is higher than the last.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean despite a three-week upward trend before the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM crossing above 0.5 alongside a PARKS rebound signals restored essential and outdoor activity confidence that spills into discretionary retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks and raising the four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM rises above 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: A joint rise in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM signals households re-engaging with outdoor and essential trips; this broadens into discretionary retail, so RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks and lifts the four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean when PARKS > 0 and GROCERY_PHARM > 0.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -37 and WORKPLACES below -22 while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, restrictions are binding; the resulting collapse in commuting and office activity depresses retail-and-recreation mobility, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than its last 28-day mean when TRANSIT < -37 and WORKPLACES < -22.
